parsing: Match '^git version (\d+)\.(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?' against the first line of `git version`; a missing patch component is 0, anything after the matched numbers (Apple, Windows, or untagged build suffixes) is ignored, and an unparseable string is below every floor.
advisories_reviewed_through: 2026-09-16: upstream tags end at v2.55.0, and the newest security batch is the 2025-07-08 release (v2.50.1 and its maintenance backports).

gates.name: acquisition
gates.below: URL opening returns unsupported_git_version naming the detected and required upstream versions; local-path browsing is unaffected. A distribution build that backports the fixes without changing its version string is refused the same way until the open decision owned by mb-h51g is made.
gates.basis: Clone-time security floor. CVE-2025-48384 (submodule path CR handling with a symlinked hooks directory) and CVE-2025-48385 (bundle-URI protocol injection during clone) were fixed in v2.43.7, v2.44.4, v2.45.4, v2.46.4, v2.47.3, v2.48.2, v2.49.1, and v2.50.1; v2.43.7 is the oldest maintained track that received them. The same releases carry the 2024 clone fixes (CVE-2024-32002, -32004, -32020, -32021, -32465). A version on an unlisted older track is refused; one on a newer track than v2.50 must be at least v2.50.1. Protocol v2 is the default above this floor (re-enabled in v2.29), and cat-file --batch-command (v2.36) is available.
